anchors.reason: Describes Brainstorm software group analysis workflow using a 16-participant MEG vision study, not this single-subject auditory tutorial dataset; a tool paper.

metadata.methods_description: MEG was acquired at 2400 Hz on a CTF 275 system with the subject seated. Each of two 6-minute runs contained 200 standard tones (440 Hz) and 40 deviant tones (554.4 Hz), with an inter-stimulus interval of 0.7-1.7 s. The recording also included 2 EEG channels, ECG, EOG and head-tracking channels, plus a 30 s empty-room recording. Head shape was digitized with a Polhemus Fastrak. Anatomy was acquired on a 1.5T MRI and processed with FreeSurfer 5.3. Stimulus delays were measured and the sound-production delay was corrected.
